declared_by: drafted by a coding agent (Claude Code) before any sensitivity result was computed; not revised after seeing results
base_population: human experiments with exactly one increased and one decreased profile (load_profiles, paired, human, blank counts rejected)
study_weighting: mean of eligible experiment contrasts within study; each eligible study weighted equally
test: two-sided exact binomial test of non-tied studies shifting up against 0.5, with an exact 95% Clopper-Pearson interval for that share
min_studies_note: a scenario row with fewer eligible studies is reported descriptively with status insufficient_support and no p or q

scenarios.population: all complete pairs; a zero-total profile scores fraction 0 (the historical rule)
scenarios.family: BH over the six Table 1 traits
scenarios.purpose: reproduce the published six-trait directions exactly

scenarios.population: complete pairs with a positive non-MediaDive total on both sides (shared comparison basis)
scenarios.family: BH over the six Table 1 traits

scenarios.population: per ratio, pairs with all four named counts positive
scenarios.purpose: the existing complete-case analysis, retained as one labelled scenario

scenarios.population: per ratio, the numerator's and the reference's fractions on exactly that ratio's S2 pairs
scenarios.family: BY over the 30 matched fraction rows
scenarios.purpose: separate population change (S1 vs S3) from estimand change (S3 vs S2)

scenarios.population: pairs with all six traits positive on both sides
scenarios.family: BH over the six fractions; BY over the 15 ratios
scenarios.purpose: one population for every reference, so ratio orderings can be compared

scenarios.population: for each of the 20 trait triples, pairs with all three traits positive on both sides; A/B, B/C and A/C on that set
scenarios.purpose: reference consistency within a triple on a shared population

scenarios.population: S2 restricted to the exact body-site label Feces
S2 restricted to every exact body-site label other than Feces
S2 with each eligible study, and then each large stratum, removed in turn
scenarios.family: BY over the 15 ratios, the other 14 p-values held at their S2 values
scenarios.decision_rule: a ratio crosses when its held-family BY q passes 0.05
scenarios.purpose: influence: how much has to change before a ratio crosses the decision rule
reported: leave-one-study-out share and p ranges, and the largest absolute share shift, as a bound on single-study influence
the minimum number of study removals that crosses the decision rule, searched over both single-sign-group removal paths, which dominate every mixed removal set
the minimum number of studies whose contrast sign must reverse to cross the decision rule, which is exact because a flip holds the sample size fixed
leave-one-condition-out and leave-one-body-site-out for every stratum holding at least min_studies_for_a_test of the ratio's eligible studies
scenarios.not_reported: a ranking of the most influential studies: every study in one sign group produces the identical share change, so any such ranking orders studies by their identifier

scenarios.population: S2 restricted to pairs whose body-site cell contains the label Feces among any others
scenarios.purpose: the fecal stratum without the exact-match artefact of S6

scenarios.population: S2 restricted to pairs with no Feces label but at least one other_gut_labels label
scenarios.purpose: whether the fecal result extends to the rest of the lower gut

scenarios.population: S2 restricted to pairs with neither a Feces label nor any other_gut_labels label
scenarios.purpose: whether anything is detected away from the gut

body_site_label_handling.problem: BugSigDB packs several body sites into one comma-joined metadata cell, and S6 and S7 match the whole cell. S7, declared as 'excluding Feces', therefore retains every multi-label experiment that names Feces alongside another site, and every experiment from the rest of the lower gut.
body_site_label_handling.resolution: S9, S10 and S11 partition the same pairs by label-set membership, so a cell naming Feces is fecal wherever else it also points, and the rest of the lower gut is its own stratum. S6 and S7 are kept unchanged as declared.
body_site_label_handling.other_gut_labels_note: Lower gastrointestinal labels as observed in the v1.3.1 export. Meconium is counted as lower-gut material, which is a judgement call; the number of pairs it alone contributes is reported in body_site_label_accounting. Upper gastrointestinal sites (stomach, duodenum, oesophagus) are deliberately left outside the gut strata.
body_site_label_handling.reported_counts: eligible studies per ratio per stratum in eligibility_by_stratum.tsv under stratum_kind gut_label_set; studies_total is not an eligible count and must not be quoted as one

decision_threshold_for_reporting: q <= 0.05 is used only to count which rows would change status; no preferred scenario or cutoff is selected

protocol_amendments.change: S8 was declared as leave-one-study-out alone. Review showed that on populations of 243 to 676 studies a single removal moves the share by about 1/n in either direction, so the scenario could not detect influence and its most-influential-study ranking was ordered by study identifier. S8 now also reports the minimum removals and minimum sign flips needed to cross the decision rule, and leave-one-condition-out and leave-one-body-site-out; the study ranking is removed.

Added after review. S6 and S7 match the whole comma-joined body-site cell, so S7 retained 15 multi-label pairs naming Feces and every other lower-gut pair, which made a claim that the signal is fecal unsupportable from S6/S7 alone. The three new strata partition the same pairs by label-set membership. S6 and S7 are unchanged.

not_done: no scenario is chosen by its q-value
no claim of absolute abundance, independent replication, or generalisation to excluded studies
